title: Intelectron hearing device for the deaf
summary: Greg Malatzi tells of Intelectron hearing device for the deaf, about 1962-1963 at Intelectron, New York City, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

plain: A researcher named Greg Malatzi, on a 2026 episode of podcast host Jesse Michels's show about a CIA scientist said to have contacted an alien council, says that around 1962 and 1963 a New York City company called Intelectron designed a device meant to let deaf people hear. He tells it as part of the background of that scientist's life and work.
